title: A Computational Approach to Measure Empathy and Theory-of-Mind from Written Texts
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is on developing and testing a computational method to classify Theory-of-Mind (ToM) levels from text. It includes a standard 'Ethics' section discussing data collection procedures and informed consent, which is typical for human-subject research. However, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark morals, ethics, or faith as a core research component.
